לְדֹר־וָדֹר: כִּי־יָדִין יְהֹוָה עַמּוֹ וְעַל־עֲבָדָיו יִתְנֶחָם: עֲצַבֵּי
הַגּוֹיִם כֶּֽסֶף וְזָהָב מַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵי אָדָם: פֶּה־לָהֶם וְלֹא יְדַבֵּֽרוּ
עֵינַֽיִם לָהֶם וְלֹא יִרְאוּ: אָזְנַֽיִם לָהֶם וְלֹא יַאֲזִֽינוּ אַף אֵין
יֶשׁ־רֽוּחַ בְּפִיהֶם: כְּמוֹהֶם יִהְיוּ עֹשֵׂיהֶם כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־בֹּטֵֽחַ

lines: הוֹדוּ לַיהֹוָה כִּי־טוֹב    כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ:
הוֹדוּ לֵאלֹהֵי הָאֱלֹהִים    כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ:
הוֹדוּ לַאֲדֹנֵי הָאֲדֹנִים    כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ:
לְעֹשֵׂה נִפְלָאוֹת גְּדֹלוֹת לְבַדּוֹ    כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ:
לְעֹשֵׂה הַשָּׁמַֽיִם בִּתְבוּנָה    כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ:
לְרוֹקַע הָאָֽרֶץ עַל־הַמָּֽיִם    כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ:
לְעֹשֵׂה אוֹרִים גְּדֹלִים    כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ:
אֶת־הַשֶּֽׁמֶשׁ לְמֶמְשֶֽׁלֶת בַּיּוֹם    כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ:
אֶת־הַיָּרֵֽחַ וְכוֹכָבִים לְמֶמְשְׁלוֹת בַּלָּֽיְלָה    כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ:
לְמַכֵּה מִצְרַֽיִם בִּבְכוֹרֵיהֶם    כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ:
וַיּוֹצֵא יִשְׂרָאֵל מִתּוֹכָם    כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ:
בְּיָד חֲזָקָה וּבִזְֽרוֹעַ נְטוּיָה    כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ:
לְגוֹזֵר יַם־סוּף לִגְזָרִים    כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ:
וְהֶעֱבִיר יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּתוֹכוֹ    כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ:
וְנִעֵר פַּרְעֹה וְחֵילוֹ בְיַם־סוּף    כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ:
לְמוֹלִיךְ עַמּוֹ בַּמִּדְבָּר    כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ:

lines: inheritance, an inheritance to His people Israel. O Lord,
Thy Name endures for ever, O Lord, Thy memory from
generation to generation. For the Lord judges His people
and has pity on His servants. The idols of the nations are
of silver and gold, the work of human hands. They have a
mouth and do not speak, they have eyes and do not see. They
have ears and do not hear, nor is there any breath in their
mouth. Like them will be those who made them, everyone
who trusts in them. O House of Israel, bless the Lord, O
House of Aaron, bless the Lord, O House of Levi, praise the
Lord, O those that fear the Lord, bless the Lord. Blessed be
the Lord from Zion, He Who dwells in Jerusalem. Halleluyah.
blocks.text: inheritance, an inheritance to His people Israel. O Lord, Thy Name endures for ever, O Lord, Thy memory from generation to generation. For the Lord judges His people and has pity on His servants. The idols of the nations are of silver and gold, the work of human hands. They have a mouth and do not speak, they have eyes and do not see. They have ears and do not hear, nor is there any breath in their mouth. Like them will be those who made them, everyone who trusts in them. O House of Israel, bless the Lord, O House of Aaron, bless the Lord, O House of Levi, praise the Lord, O those that fear the Lord, bless the Lord. Blessed be the Lord from Zion, He Who dwells in Jerusalem. Halleluyah.

lines: Thank the Lord for He is good
for His grace endures for ever
Thank the supreme God    for His grace endures for ever
Thank the supreme Lord    for His grace endures for ever
Who alone performs great wonders
for His grace endures for ever
Who made heaven with understanding
for His grace endures for ever
Who extended the earth above the water
for His grace endures for ever
Who made the great lights
for His grace endures for ever
The sun to rule by day    for His grace endures for ever
The moon and the stars to rule by night
for His grace endures for ever
Who smote Egypt through its first born
for His grace endures for ever
He led Israel from their midst
for His grace endures for ever
With a strong hand and an outstretched arm
for His grace endures for ever
Who divided the Sea of Reeds into parts
for His grace endures for ever
And passed Israel through its midst
for His grace endures for ever
He flung Pharaoh and his host into the Sea of Reeds
for His grace endures for ever
Who guided His people in the desert
for His grace endures for ever

lines: רַנְּנוּ צַדִּיקִים בַּיהֹוָה לַיְשָׁרִים נָאוָה תְהִלָּה: הוֹדוּ
לַיהֹוָה בְּכִנּוֹר בְּנֵֽבֶל עָשׂוֹר זַמְּרוּ־לוֹ: שִֽׁירוּ לוֹ שִׁיר חָדָשׁ
הֵיטִֽיבוּ נַגֵּן בִּתְרוּעָה: כִּי־יָשָׁר דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה וְכָל־מַעֲשֵֽׂהוּ
בֶּאֱמוּנָה: אֹהֵב צְדָקָה וּמִשְׁפָּט חֶֽסֶד יְהֹוָה מָלְאָה הָאָֽרֶץ:
בִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה שָׁמַֽיִם נַעֲשׂוּ וּבְֽרוּחַ פִּיו כָּל־צְבָאָם: כֹּנֵס
כַּנֵּד מֵי הַיָּם נֹתֵן בָּאוֹצָרוֹת תְּהוֹמוֹת: יִירְאוּ מֵיְהֹוָה כָּל־
הָאָֽרֶץ מִמֶּֽנּוּ יָֽגוּרוּ כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל: כִּי הוּא אָמַר וַיֶּֽהִי

lines: Who smote great kings    for His grace endures for ever
And killed mighty kings    for His grace endures for ever
Sihon king of the Amorites
for His grace endures for ever
Og king of Bashan
for His grace endures for ever
And He gave their land as an inheritance
for His grace endures for ever
As an inheritance to Israel His servant
for His grace endures for ever
In our distress He remembered us
for His grace endures for ever
And He rescued us from our enemies
for His grace endures for ever
Thank the God of Heaven
for His grace endures for ever

lines: Exult, O righteous ones, in the Lord, it is
becoming to the upright to give praise. Thank the Lord with
the zither, with the ten-stringed harp make music to Him.
Sing to Him a new song, pluck the strings well in triumph.
For upright is the word of the Lord and all His work is with
faithfulness. He loves righteousness and justice, the grace of
the Lord fills the earth. Through the word of the Lord were
the heavens made and through the breath of His mouth all
their host. He gathers like a heap the waters of the seas, and
puts the depths into store-chambers. The whole earth is afraid
before the Lord, before Him do all inhabitants of the world
tremble. For He spoke and it was, He commanded and there
it stood. The Lord has frustrated the plan of nations, baffled
the thoughts of peoples. The counsel of the Lord endures for
ever, the thoughts of His heart from generation to generation.
Fortunate the nation whose God is the Lord, the people which
He has chosen as His inheritance. The Lord has looked from
heaven, He has seen all the sons of man. From His dwelling
place does He watch over all the inhabitants of the earth.
He who has formed their hearts altogether, He understands
all their deeds. The king is not saved by the size of an army,
the warrior will not escape through the measure of strength.
Useless is the horse for victory, by the measure of its might

lines: מִזְמוֹר שִׁיר לְיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת: טוֹב לְהֹדוֹת לַיהֹוָה
וּלְזַמֵּר לְשִׁמְךָ עֶלְיוֹן: לְהַגִּיד בַּבֹּֽקֶר חַסְדֶּֽךָ וֶאֱמוּנָתְךָ
בַּלֵּילוֹת: עֲלֵי עָשׂוֹר וַעֲלֵי־נָֽבֶל עֲלֵי הִגָּיוֹן בְּכִנּוֹר: כִּי
שִׂמַּחְתַּֽנִי יְהֹוָה בְּפָעֳלֶֽךָ בְּמַעֲשֵׂי יָדֶֽיךָ אֲרַנֵּן: מַה־גָּדְלוּ
מַעֲשֶֽׂיךָ יְהֹוָה מְאֹד עָמְקוּ מַחְשְׁבֹתֶֽיךָ: אִישׁ בַּֽעַר לֹא
יֵדָע וּכְסִיל לֹא־יָבִין אֶת־זֹאת: בִּפְֽרֹחַ רְשָׁעִים כְּמוֹ־
עֵֽשֶׂב וַיָּצִֽיצוּ כָּל־פֹּֽעֲלֵי אָֽוֶן לְהִשָּׁמְדָם עֲדֵי־עַד: וְאַתָּה
מָרוֹם לְעֹלָם יְהֹוָה: כִּי הִנֵּה אֹיְבֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה כִּי־הִנֵּה אֹיְבֶֽיךָ
יֹאבֵֽדוּ יִתְפָּרְדוּ כָּל־פֹּֽעֲלֵי אָֽוֶן: וַתָּֽרֶם כִּרְאֵים קַרְנִי בַּלֹּתִי
בְּשֶֽׁמֶן רַעֲנָן: וַתַּבֵּט עֵינִי בְּשׁוּרָי בַּקָּמִים עָלַי מְרֵעִים
תִּשְׁמַֽעְנָה אָזְנָי: צַדִּיק כַּתָּמָר יִפְרָח כְּאֶֽרֶז בַּלְּבָנוֹן יִשְׂגֶּה:
שְׁתוּלִים בְּבֵית יְהֹוָה בְּחַצְרוֹת אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ יַפְרִֽיחוּ: עוֹד יְנוּבוּן
בְּשֵׂיבָה דְּשֵׁנִים וְרַעֲנַנִּים יִהְיוּ: לְהַגִּיד כִּי־יָשָׁר יְהֹוָה צוּרִי
וְלֹא־עַוְלָֽתָה בּוֹ:

lines: A psalm, a song for the Sabbath day: It is good
to thank the Lord and to sing praise to Thy Name, O Most
High, to proclaim Thy kindness in the morning and Thy
faithfulness at night, on the ten-stringed harp, through med-
itation on the zither. For Thou hast gladdened me, O Lord,
with Thy deeds, in the works of Thy hands do I exult. How
great are Thy works, O Lord, profound indeed are Thy
thoughts. A simpleton cannot know, nor can a fool under-
stand this, when the wicked flourish like grass and all evil-
doers blossom forth only to be destroyed for ever. But Thou
art supreme to eternity, O Lord. Behold Thine enemies, O
Lord, behold Thine enemies shall perish, all evil-doers shall
scatter. Then shalt Thou lift up my horn like the unicorn,
I am anointed with fresh oil. Then shall my eye look down
upon my adversaries, when evil men rise up against me my
ears shall hear. The righteous shall flourish like the palm,
like the cedar on Lebanon shall he grow. Those planted in
the House of the Lord shall blossom forth in the courts of
our God. They will yet be luxuriant in old age, full of sap
and fresh will they be, so as to proclaim that the Lord is
upright, my Rock in whom there is no wrong.

lines: The Lord reigns, clothed in majesty, the Lord
clothes Himself in strength, He girds Himself. Surely the
world stands firm without shaking. Thy throne is established
from of old, since eternity art Thou. The streams, O Lord,
the streams have raised their voice, the streams shall raise
their roar. Mightier than many waters are the breakers of the
sea but still mightier on high is the Lord. Thy testimonies
are indeed sure, holiness becomes Thine House, O Lord, for
an infinity of days.
